parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
An electron is accelerated from point A to point B by a uniform electric field, as illustrated in Fig. 3.1.
{{figure:figure_3_1.png}}
The distance between A and B is 12 mm. The velocity of the electron at A is 2.5 km s⁻¹ and at B is 18 Mm s⁻¹.
Calculate
parts.text: the acceleration of the electron, acceleration = $m s ^{-2} $

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
the change in kinetic energy of the electron, change in kinetic energy = J

(J)

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
the electric field strength.
$\text{electric field strength} = \mathrm{V\,m^{-1}}$

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
An α-particle moves from A to B in the electric field in (b).
Describe and explain how the change in the kinetic energy of the α-particle compares with that of the electron. Numerical values are not required.
